descriptions.micro: AI Agent Skills Marketplace — discover, compare & install skills for Claude, Cursor, Windsurf and more.
descriptions.short: Killer Skills is the largest AI Agent Skills Marketplace. Discover 600+ curated skills from Anthropic, Vercel, Stripe, Cloudflare, Hugging Face and more. One-click install via CLI.
descriptions.long: Killer Skills is the open-source AI Agent Skills Marketplace that aggregates official skills from Anthropic, Vercel, Stripe, Cloudflare, Hugging Face, Supabase, Google Labs, Sentry, Expo and 20+ other providers. Browse 600+ curated skills across categories like developer tools, AI/ML, design, data, finance and productivity. Install any skill with a single CLI command. Features include multi-language support (EN/ZH/JA/KO/ES/FR/DE/PT), SEO-optimized skill pages, quality scoring, and agent compatibility analysis. Built with Astro, deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
